title: It’s Getting Too Dry for Even Cactuses to Survive
summary: As droughts worsen due to climate change, new research shows that hundreds of cactus species could lose the majority of their habitats by 2100.
llm_summary: New research warns that accelerating climate‑driven droughts could strip hundreds of cactus species of most of their natural range by the end of the century. By 2100, many cacti may lose over 50 % of their habitat, underscoring how even desert‑adapted lifeforms are vulnerable to extreme water scarcity. This highlights the broader tech‑focused conversation about climate resilience and the need for data‑driven conservation strategies.
